entities.summary: Volodymyr Oleksandrovych Zolkin is a Ukrainian journalist, YouTuber and activist, living in Kyiv. He rose to prominence in 2022 after the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine, by interviewing prisoners of war for his YouTube channel, beginning 18 March 2022.
